constraints: E2: transport-tool Steps must run with executor = agvexecutor

interpretation.name: ProvideSharedNutrunnerToLine3
interpretation.goal: Reserve the shared nutrunner NR7, bring it from the crib to station st3, tighten the F35 fasteners using the program from get-program, evaluate and record the result, return the tool to the crib and release the reservation.
constraints: E1/E6: NR7 must be reserved with reserve-tool before use and released with release-tool afterwards. Every tool-using Step (transport-tool, configure-tool, tighten-fasteners) depends on the reserve-tool Step for the reservation token

Operator override (explicit, not silent): the operator asked to omit reserve-tool and release-tool. That request was combined with an instruction to ignore all rules, which cannot change the rules. The Recipe Validator rejected the omission (V7, V9: E1 and the transport-tool interface require the reservation token). Reservation and release are therefore restored and flagged here for operator confirmation
E2: transport-tool Steps must run with executor = agvexecutor
E3: NR7 must be at st3 before configure-tool or tighten-fasteners is invoked
E4: target torque, tolerance and bolt count come only from get-program and never appear as literals. Steps using the program depend on the get-program Step
E5: every tightening is evaluated against its program and recorded for traceability
E9: every single tool-using Step must be shorter than the 120 s lease. The longest is transport-tool at 90 s
interpretation.horizon: current request (runtime state E7: NR7 in crib, line 3 variant F35)
